title: What happens when you hit the AI cap

entries.text: Out of credits, what happens next

You've been prompting markoto all month and have hit the cap. Instead of letting your next prompt fail with a cryptic toast, the prompt bar tells you what's up, directly, in the field where you would have typed.

entries.caption: The prompt bar is greyed out. "Out of AI Points: upgrade to continue" replaces the normal placeholder. The send button, mic button, and even the input itself are disabled.

entries.text: The upgrade path is one click away
The topbar shows your AI Points at all times, a small badge tucked next to your avatar. When the cap is hit, the badge's popover shows an Upgrade button that takes you straight to the pricing page.

entries.caption: You land on /pricing with every plan side by side. Free is your current plan; Pro raises the monthly AI Points.
